summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on refining the definition and presentation of unique device exposure metrics. Initial definitions were debated, leading to a consensus that the metric should represent "the percent of unique devices exposed to OOH panel(s) one or more times." It was decided that detailed descriptions regarding visit bins (e.g., 1 time, 2-3 times) are unnecessary as this information is visible on the graph itself.

The documentation was reviewed and updated by [me], who added comments and confirmed the text was satisfactory. A follow-up action item was raised to update tooltips on the staging environment.
decisions: The primary metric for unique device exposure should be the percentage of unique devices seen at least once.
Detailed descriptions regarding visit frequency bins are not required in the documentation.
action_items: [me] to update tooltips on the staging environment
